xep.header:
Portable Import/Export Format for XMPP Components This document specifies a file format for importing and exporting component data to and from XMPP software &LEGALNOTICE; xxxx ProtoXEP Standards Track Standards Council
XMPP IM
pie-components &singpolyma;
0.0.1 2026-10-06 spw
Initial version.

section1.p: &xep0227; introduced a format for the import/export of XMPP data. That specification specifically says "the contents of MUC, Pubsub, and other services are out of scope for this specification". This specification exists to cover that gap.

Inside the root element from &xep0227; of <server-data/> qualified by the urn:xmpp:pie:0 namespace, may occur zero or more <component/> elements qualified by the urn:xmpp:pie:0#component namespace. Each <component/> element describes a component, and has a jid attribute that contains its JID and a type attribute that describes the type of component.
section1.example: <?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?> <server-data xmlns='urn:xmpp:pie:0'> <component xmlns='urn:xmpp:pie:0#component' jid='groups.capulet.com' type='muc'> [ ... ] </component> </server-data>
section1.p: Components may contain children to describe any data relevant to the type of component. For example, a pubsub type component may have a <pubsub xmlns="http://jabber.org/protocol/pubsub#owner"/> child.

A component may contain elements qualified by a namespace not mentioned in this specification or in &xep0227;. The exported data SHOULD be meaningful without the extensions. An importing entity that encounters a namespace that it doesn't understand, or otherwise is unable to import all given data, SHOULD ignore the unknown data, SHOULD notify the operator, and MAY offer to terminate the process.

section2.p: A component may have associated items, represented by a <item/> element under the <component/> element. The <item/> element MUST have a name attribute, which contains a type-specific identifier for this item.
section2.example: <?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?> <server-data xmlns='urn:xmpp:pie:0'> <component xmlns='urn:xmpp:pie:0#component' jid='groups.capulet.com' type='muc'> <item name='discuss'> [ ... ] </item> </component> </server-data>
section2.p: Items may contain children to describe any data from items in the relevant type of component. For example a muc type component may have items with a <archive xmlns="urn:xmpp:pie:0#mam"/> child.

An item may contain elements qualified by a namespace not mentioned in this specification or in &xep0227;. The exported data SHOULD be meaningful without the extensions. An importing entity that encounters a namespace that it doesn't understand, or otherwise is unable to import all given data, SHOULD ignore the unknown data, SHOULD notify the operator, and MAY offer to terminate the process.

section1.p: Exported data files are to be handled with care, since they contain data that users expect to be protected. An exporting entity SHOULD make sure that the generated file is not accessible to unauthorized persons, e.g. by encrypting the file with OpenPGP.
This document requires no interaction with &IANA;.
